reuse.why: Uses the existing pieces (assertNotLinkedElsewhere, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, post/getServer) but writes a whole new link function and download function rather than extracting a shared link/download routine for the identical providers.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount/linkSimpleFinAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions is a copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with only the provider name and server key changed.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, server path in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, matching where the other providers live.

scope.why: Server-side only, limited to what the new provider needs.

maintainability.why: Follows the established per-provider pattern so it is easy to read, but adds a fifth/sixth copy of the link and download flow that every future fix must touch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared link or download abstraction exists in the tree; the existing helpers it could use are used.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount (accounts/app.ts) and downloadFintegraTransactions (accounts/sync.ts) are open copies of the Akahu versions, not disguised.
